title: [review] tx_queue.py:350: Preemption path may evict vali
description: After ensure_can_push() passes due to expired entries in active_entries calculation, line 350 finds lowest priority in self._entries (which still contains the expired entry). If the expired entry has higher priority than entries being considered for eviction, a valid lower-priority entry gets evicted while the expired one remains until next expire_stale() call. This violates the principle that expired packets should be removed before evicting valid ones.
